entries.note: The Qere נפשי is more correct than the Kethib נפשו, although all the versions presuppose the latter: נשא לשוא נפש parallels לא תשא את שמי לשוא, and שוא 'the false' (= μάταια) means idols, as does מרמה — so נשבע למרמה is intelligible: 'to swear by the delusive image'. Were it simply 'swear falsely', it would sound strange that mere freedom from perjury should qualify one before God; rather it excludes those who practiced idolatry in Babylonia (Isa 65:11 ff.).
Before יעקב LXX and Peshitta have אלהי, which is necessary ('die Dich anbeten, Gott Jakobs').

After זה must be supplied הוא as in v. 10; and to גבור supply מלחמה, which is executed palilogically at the verse's close. מלך הכבוד is the Ark of the Covenant, from which God reveals himself (Exod 25:22) — hence carried into war until Josiah abolished the practice (2 Chr 35:3).
ושאו must be read as in v. 7, והנשאו, following the versions ('erhebet euch, ihr ewigen Pforten').
To ה׳ צבאות one must always supply (since ה׳ cannot stand in construct) ה׳ אלהי צבאות ישראל; ה׳ צבאות is to be viewed only as an ellipse ('Der Herr der Heerschaaren (Israels)').
The seemingly missing ב of the acrostic is still recognizable if one transposes אלהי בך to בך אלהי (Hupfeld).

entries.emendation: insert a ו half-verse, e.g. [ואל תבישני נגד איבי כי] אותך קויתי
entries.note: ו is so extraordinarily easy an acrostic letter that the singer cannot have neglected it; rather v. 5 (ה) must be divided and a half-verse beginning with ו inserted between, roughly: 'lass mich nicht beschämt werden vor meinen Feinden, denn auf Dich hoffe ich' (Hupfeld's proposed supplement is little plausible).

entries.graetz_verse: cited as V. 15/17 in his notes
entries.note: The acrostic ק is still recognizable in the doubled ר (vv. 18–19); probably read קְשׁוֹב עניי 'attend to my misery' (קשב occurs in Qal too) — the ראה is dittographic from the following verse.
entries.flag: notes cite this under two different verse numbers — verify at high res

entries.note: The close with פדה (outside the acrostic) was added later, when the psalm — though markedly individual — was put to liturgical use; cf. Ps 130:8 והוא יפדה את ישראל.
הבוגדים רקם is unintelligible; read ריקים, as Jer 14:3 (שבו כליהם ריקם = ריקים). The construction is הבוגדים ריקים with ריקים as subject ('die leichtsinnigen Abtrünnigen').
To מעולם supply עד עולם, as Ps 103:17 ('die da für immer sind').

The emphasis of אתה is superfluous here; probably read עתה 'remember me now' (on the interchange of אתה and עתה cf. Frankel-Graetz Monatsschrift 1880, p. 39 ff.) — 'denke mein jetzt um Deiner Güte willen'.
Twice ענוים in the same verse is too much; for the second the Peshitta has מסכנא, i.e. אביונים ('lehrt die Dulder Seine Wege'). ידרך has ê for יַדְרִיךְ by assonance with וילמד.
The ו of ובריתו is a dittograph from ליראיו; the sense: בריתו להודיעם 'his covenant — to make it known to them'. סוד means also 'intimate intercourse' (Prov 3:32, Job 19:19).
יחיד ועני gives no sense; read חסיד ועני, as Ps 86:2 ('denn fromm und elend bin ich').

צרות לבבי הרחיבו is unintelligible; Hupfeld's emendation is not plausible. LXX ἐπληθύνθησαν and Peshitta סגי point to רבו — the ה of הרחיבו is the ruin-fragment of הנה, and the ח slipped in thoughtlessly ('Meines Herzens Qualen sind gross').
Read חנם for חמס: 'they hate me without cause' ('ohne Grund hassen sie mich').

נעלמים cannot mean 'the deceitful' in living usage; from עלם 'veil' one says rather 'veiled, mournful, languishing' (Nah 3:11). The word is probably corrupt — perhaps read a word for 'revelers' ('mit Ausgelassenen (?) ging ich nicht um'), cf. Jer 15:17 בסוד משחקים ואעלז.
entries.flag: verify the proposed form (נעלזים?) and the interchange he cites at high res

entries.note: צרי ואיבי לי is tautological and insipid; read צרי יארבו לי 'my adversaries lie in wait for me' ('meine Feinde mir auflauern'). The very alternation of perfect and imperfect points to hypothesis (vv. 2–3 are conditional).
בזאת leaves the sense indeterminate; perhaps read ביהוה ('bin ich in dem Herrn sicher').

Much untenable has been said about לבקר; the parallel 2 Kgs 16:15 יהיה לי לבקר must be read להקריב = לקרב — so here too לְקָרֵב בהיכלו 'to offer sacrifice in His temple'. The singer was of Aaron's line, as v. 6 also indicates.

בצור ירוממני is vacuous on the common explanation and stands in poetic contradiction to the preceding wish to dwell in His tent; read מצוררי ירוממני 'He will lift me above my adversaries', like Ps 18:49 מן קמי תרוממני ('vor meinen Feinden wird Er mich erhöhen').

This defies all artificial exegesis and makes emendation imperative (the LXX reading does not fit either). To לך supply קול — קולך — and emend לבי to לנו: קולך אמר לנו בקשו פני, 'Your word said to us: seek My face' — קול construed with אמר/הגיד passes from 'voice' into 'command, word' (cf. Eccl 5:5); בקש פני ה׳ is used in later writings for התהלך את ה׳ (Ps 105:4).
אבי ואמי עזבוני points to an accomplished fact, and LXX have the perfect προσελάβετό με for וה׳ יאספני, i.e. אספני ('aber der Herr hat mich aufgenommen').
